 The nominations for the 69th Grammy Awards are being announced Monday morning.
 The Recording Academy is announcing nominees in 101 categories, including five new awards: best Asian pop music performance, best R&B collaboration or duo/group performance, best traditional pop vocal performance, best traditional folk album and best Latin song.
 The nominations announcement will be shared in a livestream kicking off at 4:45 a.m. PT/7:45 a.m. ET on Monday.
 Grammys CEO Harvey Mason Jr. and Recording Academy Board of Trustees chair Dr. Chelsey Green will be joined by Grammy-winning and -nominated artists including Alan Menken, Amy Allen, Carly Pearce, David Guetta, FYÜTCH & Aura V, Herbie Hancock, Israel Houghton, Juanes, Kehlani, Linda Perry, Meghan Foley & Michelle Holme, Olivia Dean, Pharrell Williams, Renée Fleming, YUNGBLUD and Ziggy Marley to announce the 2027 Grammy nominees.
 ABC’s Good Morning America also will feature live coverage of the announcement, and a Grammy nominations wrap-up show will air after the noms livestream. 
 The 2027 Grammy Awards will air live from Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles on Feb. 7, 2027, and simulcast across ABC, Disney+ and Hulu. A host has not yet been announced. This year’s Grammy eligibility period is Aug. 31, 2025-Aug. 28, 2026.
